subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

An inscription on or at a tomb or a grave
solution: The correct answer is **"Epitaph."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **"epitaph"** is an inscription on or at a tomb or a grave. (दिवंगत व्‍यक्ति के लिए कहे गए शब्‍द, विशेषतः उसकी समाधि पर अंकित; समाधिलेख) • **Example**: *Several **epitaphs**__ from the past have been preserved in the cathedral.* • The word is derived from the Greek word** 'epitaphios' **which means** 'a funeral oration'.** • **Epitaphs** can be funny, serious, or poetic in nature and are often used to commemorate the deceased person. • Some famous epitaphs include *"Here lies one whose name was writ in water" (John Keats) and "That's all folks" (Mel Blanc).* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Ode**: a poem meant to be sung or recited in honor of someone or something. (विशेष अवसर के लिए या विशेष व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को लक्ष्‍य कर लिखी गई कविता, संबोधन कविता) • **Imprint**: a mark or impression left by something; can refer to a physical or figurative mark. (किसी वस्‍तु को किसी सतह पर दबाने से बना निशान, छाप, मुहर, छापा) • **Carving**: the act of cutting or shaping a material (e.g. wood, stone) to create a design or pattern. (उत्‍कीर्ण वस्‍तु या कलाकृति) 21b:T88e, Here, the erroneous part is **"Sorry I will be late as a flight."**
